verdict.rationale: Relay documents rule-based automations that run in the background: auto-transfer rules that split deposits by amount or percentage, automated sweeps of idle cash into savings, recurring invoices with automatic follow-up, and automatic accounting sync. A community user confirms the automatic money partitioning works but notes external payments still have to be made by hand. These automations are fixed banking rules, not a general or AI-driven automation capability. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation builder, AI- or agent-driven autonomous actions, autonomous execution of external payments, and in-depth docs on rule configuration and triggers.
